title: FBI-UAP-D028, FD-302, “Dark Triangle with Lights,” 2011
doc_notes: This document is an FBI FD-302 interview record from 2025 regarding a UAP sighting that occurred in 2011; it contains redactions of names and specific locations.

incidents.summary: Two former military service members observed a massive black triangular object with three white lights in the corners while leaving a driveway in the evening.
incidents.quote: saw a massive black isosceles triangle shaped object flying North.
